name: errorSettles
title: An error answer taken for the end of a statement that still commits: the batch is inserted twice
timing: model time is in ticks; a worker's fence = sent + TTL - MARGIN - BUDGET, its statement lands by fence + BUDGET + SLACK, another worker may take the lane at sent + TTL + MARGIN (MARGIN = BUDGET = 1 tick)

steps.action: PUT e1/000 If-None-Match: * with request 1; S3 commits it
take the lane: lease CAS (fencing epoch 1, sent 0), rewrite the checkpoint
count check: content key of e1/0 not in central
send INSERT S1 over e1/0 with the fence (server clock <= 1)
S1's commit hangs in the Keeper retry loop; the server answers TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED (not a model step: the model has no answers)
FATAL: takes the error answer for the end of S1 and verifies at once: payload 1 counts 0, so the done prefix is empty
a tick passes; renew the lease
check again (still absent) and send the retry S2 over e1/0
S1's commit lands after all (Keeper answered; t=1 <= fence + BUDGET + SLACK = 3)

design.guard: mayAdvance(w): the worker verifies only once none of its statements is in flight (ERROR_SETTLES = false)
design.effect: step 6 is disabled: after step 4, mayAdvance(1) is false (errorSettlesDesignTest) until S1 lands or is dropped; the verify then sees payload 1 present and never sends S2
design.code: D9 (2026-09-26): only errors raised before anything is written (parse, analysis, access, TOO_MANY_PARTS, the range assertion) settle a statement at once; any other error waits until sent + TTL + slack like an unanswered statement

dropped: the writer's 200 and the queue ack (irrelevant to central); the edge's three steps (startPush, send, apply) are merged into step 1; step 5 is narrative only
